How it works

Three checks. No shortcuts.

Membership should feel effortless. Trust should not. Here is what happens before anyone appears on Nocturne.

01

Prove you are an adult

A quick self-declaration gets you in the door. At signup, our verification vendor checks a government ID and a live selfie. Minors are never permitted, without exception.

02

Creators verify too

Every creator submits government ID, proof of age, and a signed consent record for every collaborator. Records are kept and reviewed before publishing.

03

Subscribe directly

Memberships and tips go to the creator, with a transparent platform fee. Creators can pause, delete content, or revoke consent at any time.

Safety & consent

A grown-up platform acts like one.

Nocturne is designed around verified age, informed consent, and fast removal. If we cannot verify someone, they do not get published.

Age & identity verification

Government ID plus liveness checks for every creator and every member. No anonymous publishing accounts.

Written consent records

Every performer signs an informed consent form. Consent can be revoked, and content is removed when it is.

Fast takedowns

One report form, a human review queue, and a commitment to act on credible consent or impersonation reports quickly.

Zero tolerance for minors

Any apparent minor or coerced content is removed immediately and reported to NCMEC and law enforcement. There is no appeal.

The paperwork matters

Compliance is part of the product.

Read the rules, the record-keeping statement, and how to report content or request removal.
